attributes.board_name: Minnesota Board of Marriage and Family Therapy

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved activities only (sponsor- or individually approved): structured programs with an instructor (conventions, workshops, seminars, interactive media, graduate courses) and home study with an independently graded test
rules.new_licensee_rule: Hours are prorated for persons initially licensed during a reporting period. Licensed associate MFTs need no CE.
rules.audit_note: Random audits each reporting year; keep original documentation (incl. board approval number) 5 years.

topics.who: Ethical and professional studies: ethics, family law, legal issues, professional socialization/organizations, interprofessional cooperation

rules.notes: Attestation at license renewal in each odd-numbered year. Board-approved supervisors have additional CE under Minn. R. 5300.0170, item D.
